title: Drake Maye's return to form reminds us anything is possible with this team
channel_name: All 32 NFL Podcast w/ Mike Giardi
text: After last week’s catastrophic loss against the Jaguars, a win in Buffalo seemed like a tall task for the Patriots. Against all odds, Drake Maye and co. rose to the occasion, earning a 29-26 victory over their division rivals. Mike Giardi comes at you with a solo edition of the All 32 NFL Podcast, with much better news to report. Drake Maye was back to playing like the guy who nearly won the MVP last season with 269 passing yards, 3 touchdown passes, and 53 rushing yards to get the better of Josh Allen and the Bills. Mike gets into that, how Maye bailed out the offensive line, why being the underdog suits Mike Vrabel, New England’s coaching advantage, Efton Chism and Romeo Doubs coming up big, and the EDGE group that continues to exceed expectations. Join James Seltzer and Eliot Shorr-Parks as they discuss the offense's struggles to start the year and if they think anything can change between now and Sunday's game against the Jaguars in London. Presented by Ashley, America's number one furniture and mattress store.

title: [FULL EPISODE] Bears continue to lean heavily into the rivalry with the Packers
channel_name: Take The North: A Chicago Bears Podcast
text: It's Packers week and Ben Johnson's Bears continue to not shy away from how they feel about the rivalry. Dan Wiederer and Mark Grote remark on how the Bears have become the aggressor in the rivalry and explain why fans should follow the team's lead. Also in this episode, running back D'Andre Swift appeared to be benched after a bad fumble against the Jets. Will he resume his typical role in the next game? And quarterback Tyson Bagent will be starting once again this week. So when can we expect Caleb Williams to return?

title: QUARTERLY REVIEW: Bears Are Only Getting Better With Packers Up Next
channel_name: Hoge & Jahns: a show about the Chicago Bears
text: The Bears are 3-1 through four weeks, and Hoge & Jahns are taking a look at where the team stands heading into a huge rivalry matchup with the Packers. The guys break down the biggest takeaways from the first four weeks, what’s working for Ben Johnson’s team and where the Bears still have room to improve. Plus, Kaitlin Sharkey of WGN 9 joins the show to preview the rivalry from the Wisconsin perspective and share her thoughts on the Bears heading into Week 5. All that and more on another live edition of Hoge & Jahns. Hosted by Simplecast, an AdsWizz company.
